description: Implementation of LDPC rate dematcher functions for 5G NR, including initialization, rate dematching, soft bit combination, interleaving, and deinterleaving methods.

classes.name: ldpc_rate_dematcher_impl
classes.description: Class implementing LDPC rate dematching algorithms for 5G NR, including initialization, rate dematching, and interleaving functions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the dematcher with new data flag and configuration metadata.

methods.name: rate_dematch
methods.description: Performs rate dematching on input LLRs to produce output LLRs, adjusting for code block size and modulation.

methods.name: combine_softbits
methods.description: Combines two sets of soft bits (LLRs) into one by summation.

methods.name: allot_llrs
methods.description: Allocates and processes LLRs, handling systematic bits, filler bits, and parity bits, with optional copying or combining.

methods.name: deinterleave_llrs
methods.description: Selects appropriate deinterleaving method based on modulation order.
